svg.aria-label: Field Notes — Operating Principles of Muhammad Ashir
svg.title: Field Notes — Operating Principles
svg.desc: Signature portrait of Muhammad Ashir beside three animated engineering principles on cryptographic guardrails, auditability, and resilient systems.

g.text: Rules I write before I write code.
Steal the loop. Keep the cryptographic receipts.
“Autonomous agents shouldn't hold the company credit card without cryptographic guardrails.”
“If it can't be replayed, audited or explained, it isn't production-grade intelligence.”
“Build systems that fail loudly, log precisely, and recover quietly.”
TRUST IS A SYSTEM PROPERTY, NOT A PROMPT.
